findings.title: MetricAlertDetectorHandler is now abstract and cannot be instantiated
findings.body: `MetricAlertDetectorHandler` now subclasses `StatefulDetectorHandler` with only `pass`, but `StatefulDetectorHandler` declares four abstract members (`counter_names`, `get_dedupe_value`, `get_group_key_values`, and the newly added `build_occurrence_and_event_data`) and inherits `abc.ABC`. Because none of them are implemented, `MetricAlertDetectorHandler(detector)` raises `TypeError: Can't instantiate abstract class ...`. This is reached from `Detector.detector_handler` for any detector of type `metric_alert_fire`, so `process_detectors` will blow up at runtime instead of returning no results (previously the handler returned `[]` safely). Either implement the abstract hooks or keep the class non-registered/abstract until they exist.

findings.title: New abstract hook breaks existing StatefulDetectorHandler subclasses
findings.body: `build_occurrence_and_event_data` was added as an `@abc.abstractmethod` on `StatefulDetectorHandler`. Any existing subclass (e.g. `MetricAlertDetectorHandler` in `src/sentry/incidents/grouptype.py`) that does not define it can no longer be instantiated, producing a `TypeError` at handler construction time rather than a clear failure at import/registration. If subclasses are expected to be rolled out incrementally, consider providing a default implementation that raises `NotImplementedError` only when a non-OK status actually needs an occurrence, so that detectors without an occurrence builder degrade gracefully.

findings.title: get_state_data raises KeyError when counter_names is empty
findings.body: In `get_state_data`, `counter_updates` is only populated inside `if self.counter_names:`; otherwise it stays `{}`. The loop below then unconditionally does `counter_updates[gk]`, which raises `KeyError` for a handler that legitimately tracks no counters (an empty `counter_names` list is a valid implementation of the abstract property). Use `counter_updates.get(gk, {})` or initialize the dict for all group keys.

findings.title: Multi-group test asserts occurrence built with the wrong value
findings.body: `test_state_results_multi_group` sends `group_2` with value 10 but builds the expected occurrence with `value=6`. The test only passes because `build_mock_occurrence_and_event` ignores the `value` argument, so the test cannot detect if the wrong value is forwarded from `evaluate_group_key_value` to `build_occurrence_and_event_data`. Make the mock occurrence depend on `value` (e.g. put it in `evidence_data`) and pass the real value, so the plumbing of `value` and `new_status` is actually verified.

findings.title: Stale TODO comment about stateful detector
findings.body: The comment `# TODO: This will be a stateful detector when we build that abstraction` sits directly above a class that now subclasses `StatefulDetectorHandler`, so it is misleading to future readers. It should be removed or replaced with the actual remaining work (implementing the required abstract hooks).
